en.title: CRM IMP
en.summary: Full-stack lead management system with AI training, autodialer, prospecting, webinars, trends radar, and VSL tooling.
en.role: Full-stack development · Product UI · Module architecture
en.challenge: Turn a detailed functional specification into a robust web system — React frontend, Node.js + Python backend, database integrations — with clear navigation and business rules already defined.
en.solution: Implemented a modular CRM shell (AI training, automatic dialing, prospecting, webinar studio, trends radar, VSL) with consistent dark-mode dashboard UX and API-backed workflows for lead growth teams.
en.results: A cohesive operations platform where teams switch modules without leaving a unified product experience.
highlights: Modular dashboard for lead-growth workflows
AI training & simulation capabilities
Autodialer campaigns, queues, and quick actions
Webinar, trends radar, and VSL tooling in one shell
